reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the lab-tested line with the QR code, which I like, but it is $1 a serving for a brand with no reviews, and my usual bottle costs a fraction of that. I reorder the same bottle, so a new name has to clear a high bar.
objection: A dollar a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood cost $0.20-0.40, and no reviews and no NSF or USP seal, just the brand's own say-so on which lab it uses.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews, an NSF or USP certification, and a price closer to $0.60 a serving, or a trial box of 7 sachets at a low price.
